source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.8 (PDF 274) in the book's order, with the correction and a self-check.

blocks.text: Tamam nuclear processes, jaise nuclear reactions aur nuclear decays, conservation laws (kul miqdar na badalne ke qanoon) ko follow karte hain:

items: Energy, momentum aur charge ki conservation. Is mein nucleon number (A) aur charge number (Z) bhi shamil hain: reaction se pehle aur baad dono ka jor barabar rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab nucleon number ko '(N)' likhti hai. Kitab ki apni Eq. 12.1 mein nucleon (mass) number A hai aur N neutrons ki tadaad hai. Is liye yahan nucleon number A hona chahiye.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Hadrons: mesons, maslan pions aur kaons; baryons, maslan protons, neutrons, omega, sigma aur lambda particles. Non-hadrons: leptons (electrons, muon, neutrinos); photons aur gravitons.

blocks.prompt: Nitrogen-14 (Z = 7) par alpha particle marne se oxygen-17 (Z = 8) banta hai. Banne wala particle kya hai, aur dikhaiye ke nucleon number aur charge number conserve rehte hain (numerical 12.3, 12.4).
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen-14 + helium-4 → oxygen-17 + X. Nucleons: 14 + 4 = 18 = 17 + A, to A = 1. Charge: 7 + 2 = 9 = 8 + Z, to Z = 1. Banne wala particle proton (hydrogen-1) hai. Nucleon number (pehle aur baad 18) aur charge number (pehle aur baad 9) dono conserve rehte hain.

items: Nuclear reactions aur decays mein energy, momentum, charge (nucleon number A aur charge number Z samet), baryon number aur lepton number conserve rehte hain.
Hadrons: mesons (pions, kaons) aur baryons (p, n, omega, sigma, lambda); non-hadrons: leptons, photons, gravitons.
